major_cooldowns.name: Stormkeeper
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown in single target and pre-pull it about 3 seconds before the boss, but hold it when Ascendance is up within 10 seconds so it lands one or two GCDs before Ascendance, and never delay it more than 10 seconds; on cleave fights delay it until you can Chain Lightning 5 targets.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 191634 is the cast id and its self aura; base cooldown 60s, the Midnight season 1 4pc adds a charge and does not change the cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Line it up with Bloodlust, Heroism or Time Warp, Light's Potential, on-use trinkets, a Stormkeeper cast one or two GCDs earlier and, in multi-target, the Purging Flames buff from Voltaic Blaze; check the boss timers first and pair it with Spiritwalker's Grace when movement threatens the window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 114050 is the Elemental cast id; 1219480 is its self aura and 114052 the Restoration version.

major_cooldowns.name: Ancestral Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it high in the priority every cooldown, right after Stormkeeper in the opener, so the free instant cast lands on a hard-cast spell for the extra 10% damage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 443454 name-verified and castable; the Farseer replacement for Nature's Swiftness, so it is absent from Stormbringer parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Nature's Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown high in the priority and spend the free instant on a hard-cast spell, ideally to keep casting through a movement window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 378081 is the Shaman cast id; 132158 is the Druid ability of the same name. Replaced by Ancestral Swiftness on Farseer builds.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Elemental
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep it rolling on cooldown and refresh Flame Shock or Voltaic Blaze in the last 3 seconds of the elemental, since Flame Shock's damage and pandemic window are doubled while it is out.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 198067 name-verified and castable; not pressed in the sampled Stormbringer parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Spiritwalker's Grace
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for a movement mechanic that would otherwise cut casts, above all inside Ascendance where it buys full uptime on the window.

rule.description: Open Stormkeeper, Lava Burst, then Ascendance
rule.action: Pre-cast Stormkeeper about 3 seconds before the pull and Lava Burst about 1.5 seconds out so it lands on contact, then send Ascendance with Light's Potential and your on-use trinkets.
Cast Stormkeeper one or two GCDs ahead of Ascendance; hold Stormkeeper when Ascendance is under 10 seconds away, but never bank it longer than 10 seconds.

rule.description: Flame Shock stays up on your target
rule.action: Refresh Flame Shock, or Voltaic Blaze, at 6 seconds or less remaining and use that flexible instant to cover movement; without it Lava Burst loses its guaranteed crit, Inferno Arc's 10% damage and every Lava Surge proc.

rule.description: Refresh Flame Shock late, never clip it
rule.action: Refresh Flame Shock only inside its pandemic window, at 5 seconds or less remaining, so the leftover time carries into the new 18 seconds; both numbers double while Fire Elemental is out.

rule.description: Lava Surge procs spent on Lava Burst
rule.action: Cast Lava Burst on every Lava Surge proc; it is instant, so spend it while moving rather than hard-casting Lava Burst later.

rule.description: Elemental Blast not at capped Tempest stacks
rule.action: In multi-target, cast Elemental Blast and Earthquake at 1 stack of Tempest or fewer; at 2 stacks send Tempest first, as long as Stormkeeper is under 4 stacks.

rule.description: Chain Lightning over Lightning Bolt in AoE
rule.action: Swap Lightning Bolt for Chain Lightning from 3 targets on Stormbringer and 2 on Farseer; the exception is a Stormkeeper charge on a priority target, which still wants Lightning Bolt.

Hold Earthquake for 4 stacked targets on a Stormbringer Elemental Blast build, 3 with Earth Shock or on Farseer, and only when they live its full 6 seconds; keep an Elemental Blast buff up between them.
